title: createDB
subtitle: Create a database instance
description: Creates a new database instance with the specified name and storage driver.
content: The `createDB` function creates a new database instance that provides a Redis-like async key-value API.

rows.name: nameOrOptions
rows.description: Database name as a string, or an options object with name and driver

returns.description: Database instance with async key-value methods

examples.title: DB Methods
examples.description:
The returned database instance provides these async methods:

• get<T>(key) - Retrieve a value by key
• set(key, value) - Store a value
• has(key) - Check if key exists
• del(key) - Delete a key
• scan(pattern) - Find keys by pattern (`*` wildcard)
• drop() - Delete all data for this database
